cached_context_binding.statistics_semantics: Previously read complete frozen V4 input in the preceding API simulation; same reference SHA as R17 coordinate audit. It is cached context, not remined or freshly reopened source data.

historical_exact_value_binding.source: Parent-confirmed unchanged precise Steer100 values; current summary.md records their rounded values.

selection_reason: R7 all-attempted mean 7.663567433357239 and unique-valid mean 7.500726828208337 exceed R17 by 0.06897522926330524 and 0.050513570736616664. R17 improves native and its best exceeds R7, but does not replace the measured global mean winner.

strength_insufficiency.evidence: R17 mean injection RMS is 99.90447% of R7, all 50 control nodes are active, actual endpoint VJP FD and full native/zero certificates pass; absolute paired head response is 0.40425681114196776.

coordinate_target_revision.evidence: R17 improves its coordinate proxies more strongly than R7 while final affinity mean is lower. Teacher qualification and conditional priors may steer to a geometrically achievable but affinity-suboptimal target; neither cause is identified by this comparison.

input_feature_insufficiency.evidence: R17 already uses intact XYZ pointcloud teachers, so a claim that it fails merely because it lacks full coordinates is contradicted. Missing local receptor weighting, continuation response or incorrect offline label semantics remain hypotheses.

final_affinity_comparison.provenance: Means and valid count independently recovered from supplied outcome deltas; best/top5 not supplied.

active_control_audit.interpretation: Coordinate differences persist and can amplify during native continuation; their RMS does not establish affinity persistence, damping, or physical velocity. No numerical R17 window-head series is supplied.

secondary_coordinate_and_energy_evidence.interpretation: Greater geometry-proxy improvement is not a sufficient affinity criterion. R17 has slightly better strain median than native but a worse p90 and lower evaluable/valid coverage (96 versus R7 99). Isolated-ligand MMFF is secondary and does not measure receptor binding energy; graph changes remain ungated.

lineage_counterevidence.cached_provenance: Previously read frozen V4 input; no raw trajectory remining in this response.
lineage_counterevidence.label: mean joint-latent lasthead affinity among surviving descendants at t=0.99
lineage_counterevidence.interpretation: Early terminal-qualified diversity is limited. Equal cap2 avoids the superseded 140-teacher capacity confound, but early availability differs (17 instead of original 28), and qualification/base priors still change. Survival feature association is not significant terminal affinity evidence. Equal-batch-then-ancestor base mass is altered by nearest-K and conditional score weighting.

registered_ablation_assessment.can_test: Whether conditional offline terminal-credit score weighting is harmful within this fixed teacher pool, versus the matched beta=2 program.
cannot_test: Credit-dependent teacher eligibility remains; this is not a teacher-selection-bias ablation.
Nearest-K, coordinate kernel and base prior remain; beta=0 does not cancel all conditional priors.
A result cannot independently validate lasthead.99 as decoded t1 affinity, distinguish early extinction effects, or establish target causality.

registered_ablation_assessment.design: same terminal-lineage library and conditional settings, eta=0.18 versus 0.3
registered_ablation_assessment.can_test: Dose sensitivity of this fixed coordinate target and whether weakening the pull improves final mean or energy tail. Actual realized RMS must be measured rather than assumed to scale exactly by 0.6.
cannot_test: Lower dose leaves terminal-credit qualification and conditional-prior selection bias intact.
It cannot identify missing coordinates, repair an inappropriate target direction, or prove a need to escalate above eta=0.3.
An improvement would support nonmonotone dose response within this target; it would not prove which teacher mechanism caused it.

coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.name: teacher_qualification_and_conditional_prior_calibration
coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.formula: For intact teacher clouds Q_k, conditional weights pi_k(z) proportional to exp(base_log_weight_k - d(A,Q_k)^2/(2*T) + beta*s_k), restricted to nearest K; base_log_weight=-log(number of eligible teachers in that batch), with equal batch then ancestor allocation. R19 sets beta=0 only.
coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.proposal: After these ablations, compare teacher qualification or offline decoded-final labels with fixed cap2/K4/T4 and matched effective dose as separate controls; keep extinction null and forbid whole-window high/low credit strata. Separate offline label calibration from online coordinate derivative.

coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.name: receptor_local_coordinate_attention_with_intact_clouds
coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.formula: Freeze a_i=b+sum_r w_r*exp(-||A_i-p_r||^2/(2*l^2)), b>0; for fixed soft assignment S to intact Q_k use d_k^2=sum_i a_i*||Z_i-sum_j S_ijk*Q_kj||^2/sum_i a_i. R=-sum_k pi_k*rho(d_k), rho(s)=delta^2*(sqrt(1+(s/delta)^2)-1); differentiate only Z=f_theta(x_t,t,fixed self-conditioning).
coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.proposal: Test a receptor-local coordinate residual with local XYZ means/covariances and continuous node functions, preserving intact teachers and force outside selected regions through b>0. Start from R7 as control and change one representation factor at matched dose. Verify node fidelity, receptor frame, scale and conditional FD before any new GPU comparison.
coordinate_improvement_hypotheses.evidence_constraints: Whole-window positive occupancy with negative initial/final contrasts does not justify constant signed attraction; covariance signs do not imply universal compression. Current 400 survival tests cannot supply significant terminal-affinity feature weights. Prior regional information-audit excess RMS is not causal affinity evidence, and precise region selection requires its bound support data.

interpretation_review.agree: Actual intervention is active and useful relative to native, but worse than R7 on primary final mean; target-library or conditional-prior revision is more justified than unqualified dose escalation.
interpretation_review.qualify: Teacher-count claims must use cap2 and early availability 17->28, not the superseded cap10/140 narrative. Target composition, label semantics, early sparse support and conditional prior are plausible mechanisms, not established causes.
interpretation_review.information_audit_limit: Coordinate compression or nonnegative excess residual RMS alone cannot attribute R7 or R17 affinity outcomes to missing input features.

provenance_roles.reference_note: The supplied reports label different reference roles; do not silently equate the control teacher SHA and frozen window-end continuation observation reference.

uncertainties: 100 candidate slots in two seed42 batches are not 100 independent replicated experiments; adaptive round selection introduces discovery bias, and there is no held-out generalization claim.
Historical Steer100 is a historical 100-sample subset, not a verified full-experiment maximum or equal-budget paired comparison.
Affinity is the model's final decoded-coordinate prediction, not experimental CK2 binding; best, top5, valid and unique statistics have different selection semantics.
FD and full-zero reports validate derivative/control integrity at tested conditions, not target usefulness; raw trajectory artifacts were not independently rehashed here.
R19/R24 designs are described in the supplied interpretation/task, but their registry files and new outcomes are outside this frozen input; no completion or success is claimed.
R17-versus-R7 does not isolate terminal labels, teacher availability and priors. No formal causal attribution or significant terminal feature discovery is claimed.
